mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment (UNRATE exceeding 9.0%) triggers negative S&P 500 returns as investor confidence weakens amid labor market stress.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate declines alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE), the combination signals accommodative monetary policy and strong demand, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not significantly predict positive returns, or their correlation weakens in non-triggering periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising supply (INDPRO) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signal robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive in late-cycle regimes, or the combination of INDPRO and UNRATE does not correlate with returns.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained unemployment below 8.5% (UNRATE <8.5%) reflects a strong labor market, fostering investor optimism and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE remains below 8.5%, or returns are negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in supply (INDPRO) indicates robust production and demand, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO's upward trend does not translate to significant positive returns, or the effect wanes over time.

mechanism_narrative: When supply (INDPRO) crosses above 98.0, it signals a surge in production capacity, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO crosses above 98.0, or the effect is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in demand (GDPC1 exceeding 11340.9) signals robust economic activity, driving investor confidence and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 crosses above 11340.9, or the effect is not sustained.
